newsitem.title: USA: Woolworth says Eastbay holders approve deal.
newsitem.headline: Woolworth says Eastbay holders approve deal.

text.p: Woolworth Corp said Friday shareholders of Eastbay Inc have approved a deal for the retailer to acquire the athletic footwear and apparel marketer.
With the completion of the deal, Eastbay will now become part of Woolworth's athletic group, which oeprates 3,500 stores worldwide, including Foot Locker and Champs Sports, it said.
"We expect Eastbay to be a net contributor to Wooldworth's earnings in fiscal 1997," said Roger Farah, Woolworth's chairman and chief executive officer.
Woolworth is paying about $140 million for the deal, plus $6 million that becomes payable if certain post-closing performance targets are achieved.
